info.name: Gallabox WhatsApp Scenarios
info.description:
Generated from Whatsapp scenarios -updated.docx (11 scenarios only).

Folder names match the updated document.
Every request Description starts with FIELD GUIDE (REQUIRED / OPTIONAL).
Body requests also show an annotated body with // OPTIONAL comments (docs only).
Body tab still sends clean JSON so Send works.
Optional query params are unchecked (disabled) in Postman.
Easy auth: POST /api/whatsapp/session with X-Gallabox-Secret → {{token}}.
Set vars: baseUrl, whatsappSecret, mobile, pincode, groupCode.
